description: External and internal alterations including installation of an air-conditioning condenser unit within acoustic enclosure on top of the flat roof of the mansard roof extension; replacement of double-glazed timber sash windows with slimline double-glazed timber sash windows at fourth-floor level on the rear elevation and fifth-floor level on the front elevation; replacement of timber sliding doors with new timber sliding doors at fifth-floor level on the rear elevation; resurfacing and re-waterproofing of the flat roof of the mansard roof extension; retention of an existing rooflight; and installation of new decking to the existing fifth-floor rear roof terrace
site_name: Fourth And Fifth Floor Flat, 21 Cornwall Gardens, LONDON, SW7 4AW
